skeptical-audit.why: the change defines 'fixed' and 'verified' in the evidence contract this skill owns and adds claim-lint rules that refuse those words without their record; it is the skill's evidence discipline made mechanical.
skeptical-audit.what: added section 6 to references/evidence-discipline.md (fixed = red-green-red-on-revert; verified = command + exit + hash; green suite proves only its cases; HIGH blocks done), and four claim-lint rules (fixed/verified/suite/done-open-high) with document-level grounding.
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

verifiable-quality-gates.why: a defect's 'fixed' bar (red again on revert) is exactly a discrimination test aimed at the fix, and each new check (the claim-lint rules, the open-high checker) ships a committed test that fails if the check is a no-op.
verifiable-quality-gates.what: added the 'What fixed and verified mean' section framing a fixed-test as a red-on-revert discrimination test, and committed discriminating tests for both new checks (bad case flags, good case passes, no-op flips them).
quotes: test must FAIL when the check is replaced by a no-op

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: the four acceptance scenarios for this issue are added to the executable harness and driven by step definitions that run the real scripts, so they actually execute rather than only parse.
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: added the fixed/verified scenarios to features/evidence/claims-match-evidence.feature with step defs driving claim-lint and check-open-high-findings, declared the operator audience, and regenerated the datastore + coverage log.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment.

architectural-decision-records.why: defining fixed/verified and choosing how to enforce HIGH-blocks-done are significant decisions with real alternatives, so they ship an ADR in the same change.
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR-0092 recording the definitions, the claim-lint document-level grounding choice, and the structured-log checker chosen over a prose rule for HIGH-blocks-done, with considered options and named limits.
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

pattern-selector.why: HIGH-blocks-done had two real shapes (guess an open HIGH from report prose vs read the structured review log) and the grounding had two (line-adjacent vs document-level); the decision names the structure chosen on purpose and where the real guarantee lives.
pattern-selector.what: chose a dedicated structured-log checker (not a prose rule) for HIGH-blocks-done and document-level grounding for claim-lint, recorded in ADR-0092's considered options with the forces and the discriminating tests as the guarantee.
quotes: the structure that fits the forces this system will actually face, chosen on purpose

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: both new checks are tested at the layer that owns the risk - integration tests that spawn the real script against fixtures, matching the test type to the risk.
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: added test cases that run the real claim-lint (the four new rules, bad flags + good passes) and a new test file that runs the real check-open-high-findings across open/resolved/waived/scoped/fail-closed cases.
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

judge-arch.why: a change that adds enforcement rules to two skills plus a new checker must pass a fresh-context review against the four questions before it is done.
judge-arch.what: ran a fresh-context subagent review of the full diff (claim-lint false-positives/regressions, the open-high checker, docs-vs-code, discrimination), resolved its findings, and recorded the review in docs/arch-reviews/log.jsonl.
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion. Every review does all of them.

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: offline evidence-discipline tooling over repo-local trusted files (report drafts, the review log); no untrusted input, auth, secret, network, or user-facing surface; scripts make no outbound web calls (arch gate enforces).

arch-encode.why: the audit finding (fixed-without-revert, done-over-open-HIGH) is encoded as claim-lint rules plus the evidence contract section 6, each pinned by its own discriminating test, rather than as a new nearest-scoped AGENTS.md/decisions.md negative-example rule; the enforcement lives in the skill the rule belongs to.

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal or regulated data, storage, retention, migration, or backup is touched.

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no running system, service boundary, data model, or scaling surface; skill docs, claim checkers, and tests.

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy, migration, feature flag, or rollback of a running system.

sre-operational-readiness.why: no running service, SLO, alert, or golden signal.

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing UI; no .tsx/.jsx/.html/.css surface in the change.

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no interactive user-facing surface; the skill docs follow house style but there is no UI or flow.
